title: Characterizing Weak Separability for Simon-Periodic Distinguishers
summary: Existing periodic-function types are limited; the unresolved task is to determine which weak separability properties support Simon-periodic construction.

formal_statement.body: A separability framework for constructing periodic functions for Simon's algorithm includes strong, semi-strong, and weak separability, but the known types of periodic functions remain limited. Characterize exactly which weak separability properties can be used to construct such periodic functions for Simon-periodic distinguishers.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of periodic distinguishers constructed using Simon's algorithm.
parameters: Separability type: strong, semi-strong, or weak, as categories in the construction framework
scope.unresolved_remainder: Characterize exactly which weak separability properties can be used to construct periodic functions for Simon-periodic distinguishers.

citations.label: Quantum Periodic Distinguisher Construction: Symbolization Method and Automated Tool

progress.summary: The source identifies a limited set of known periodic-function types and says that the usable weak separability properties remain unclear. It presents their exact characterization as an open task.
citation_labels: Qun Liu et al., Quantum Periodic Distinguisher Construction: Symbolization Method and Automated Tool
